endorsements.name: Oliver Hader
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-59013
endorsements.description: An open‑redirect vulnerability in GeneralUtility::sanitizeLocalUrl of TYPO3 CMS 9.0.0–9.5.54, 10.0.0–10.4.53, 11.0.0–11.5.47, 12.0.0–12.4.36, and 13.0.0–13.4.17 allows an attacker to redirect users to arbitrary external sites, enabling phishing attacks by supplying a manipulated, sanitized URL.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 4.0, 5.3)
